name: Connecticut
programName: HUSKY C Medicaid with a Spend-Down

period.description: Your spend-down covers a six-month period; your notice lists the amount and the dates.

submission.description: Send bills with the Spend-down FastLink cover sheet to the DSS ConneCT Scanning Center by mail. Providers can fax bills for you.

notes: Unpaid bills you still owe can count, no matter how old.
Bills you already paid only count if the care was in your current six-month period.
Health insurance premiums, co-pays and deductibles count.
Send final bills, not estimates, and keep copies of everything you send.
